title: Find All Disappeared Numbers
description: An array `nums` has length `n`, and each value is in the range 1 through `n`. Return, in increasing order, every value in that range that does not occur in `nums`. Input: `nums`. Output: the list of missing values.
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
